review:
Underground treasure on 24 separate reels, mixing several Wazdan mechanics. Land 4 Bonus symbols on the highlighted central reels for Hold the Jackpot, starting with 3 respins and jackpots up to 1,500x.

Cash Infinity symbols stay until the bonus, Sticky to Infinity locks Mystery symbols, and Moving Cash Out travels down a reel collecting values, multiplying them by up to 300%. Chance Level changes how often the bonus hits, not what it pays. High volatility, 96.13% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
